per_question_answers.question: What different seat-billing mismatches did customers report?
per_question_answers.expected_answer: Customers reported a renewal estimate that differed from the charge and an invoice whose seat total differed from the admin page on the same day. Separately, support explained that archived seats stay billable until cycle close, and the customer wanted that rule shown in the UI.
per_question_answers.raw_model_answer:
Status: answered

Customers reported invoice and admin pages showing different seat totals on the same day [V2-FB-0070, V2-FB-0154, V2-FB-0034]. In one case, the customer said only one of several workspaces seemed affected; support reproduced it in one workspace but not a smaller test workspace [V2-FB-0154, V2-SUP-0033]. Another customer said a seat-adjustment line could not be traced to specific people and that two colleagues got different results [V2-FB-0346].
